jobs.description:
job description

We are modernizing a business-critical Payroll product where correctness matters. As part of this transformation, we are building quality engineering AI-first and automation-first from the beginning.

This is not a traditional manual QA role, and it is also not a conventional test-automation role where AI is simply used to work faster. We want to use AI as a core part of how we understand existing behaviour, create test coverage, generate and manage test data, identify gaps, analyse failures and continuously improve quality.

You will help establish this capability from the ground up.

your tasks

  • Build an AI-first, automation-first quality engineering approach for Payroll
  • Create automated regression coverage for existing and newly modernized Payroll capabilities
  • Use AI as the primary tool to discover, generate and continuously improve relevant test scenarios
  • Create characterization and golden-master style tests for existing behaviour that is not sufficiently protected today
  • Build automated API, integration and service-level testing
  • Establish AI-driven test-data management as a core capability:
    • generate realistic and controlled test data
    • create variations and edge cases
    • maintain reusable test-data sets
    • identify missing scenarios
    • manage data safely and reproducibly
  • Work with Payroll domain experts to translate complex business rules into automated, repeatable validation
  • Use AI to analyse existing system behaviour and identify regression risks
  • Use AI to analyse test failures, cluster defects and help identify likely root causes
  • Integrate automated quality controls and quality gates directly into the delivery process, making quality engineering part of development rather than a separate phase at the end

your profile

  • Several years of experience in QA automation, quality engineering or software testing, with a strong understanding of automated testing principles
  • Practical experience with API, integration and backend testing as well as CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates
  • Good scripting skills and the ability to automate repetitive technical tasks
  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to understand complex business rules, working closely with engineers and domain experts
  • An automation-first mindset: repetitive validation is automated by default, not performed manually
  • An AI-first mindset: you naturally consider AI and automation when solving quality-engineering challenges.
  • Payroll knowledge is not required, you will work closely with experienced Payroll domain experts.
Mandatory: AI-first test data management

About the role:

The company builds blockchain infrastructure that lets companies create wallets and launch products on chain through simple APIs. We are hiring our first dedicated quality lead: one senior person who owns testing and release quality across the whole platform.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a management seat. You will build the QA function from zero: the test strategy, the automation frameworks, and the release process. We expect AI to be central to how you work, from test generation to risk analysis, because that is how one lead covers an entire platform.

You will work directly with the tech leads of each product team. As the function proves itself, you will help hire and shape the QA engineers who join after you.

What you will do:

  • Own the QA function end to end: test strategy, coverage priorities, and quality standards across all products.
  • Build test automation frameworks from scratch across web and API layers with a modern framework such as Playwright, and wire them into CI so every deployment runs through automated quality gates.
  • Make AI a core part of the quality toolchain: AI-assisted test generation, pull request analysis, risk-based test targeting, and whatever else multiplies your coverage.
  • Own release quality: define the regression baseline, run release candidates through it, triage and prioritise defects, and give the go/no-go recommendation before production deployments.
  • Set up risk-based testing across the platform, focusing effort where failures cost the most.
  • Work with tech leads and product management to bring quality practices into how features are designed and built, not only how they are tested at the end.
  • Establish defect prevention practices and act as the internal reference on testing for the engineering teams.

What we are looking for:

  • 7+ years in software testing and test automation, including experience owning a QA function or leading QA on a product, not only executing within one.
  • Strong automation engineering skills in TypeScript/JavaScript with a modern framework, Playwright for example.
  • Active, hands-on use of AI in quality work: generating tests, analysing coverage and risk, or building AI-assisted tooling around testing. For us this is the default way of working, not an experiment.
  • Solid API testing experience and the ability to test backend services directly, not only through the UI.
  • Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar) and maintaining them as a reliable signal rather than a flaky one.
  • A track record of building test infrastructure from zero and getting engineering teams to adopt it.
  • Comfort operating with minimal direction: you define what good looks like, propose the plan, and execute it.

Our Platform team builds the company's own platform: web funnels, payments, subscriptions and integrations with third-party services. It's the core that all our products run on.

So we need a mature specialist who finds the root cause, communicates clearly and helps improve how we work, not someone who only runs test cases.

What you'll do

  • Test new features end to end during development: frontend, backend, APIs and third-party integrations
  • Run regression testing before releases and smoke testing on production after each release
  • Validate business and technical requirements with Product and Engineering before development starts
  • Investigate defects with logs, API responses and network traffic, and write clear, reproducible bug reports
  • Be the first line for requests from Monetization, Finance and Product Tech: reproduce the issue, assess severity and escalate with facts
  • Maintain test documentation in TestRail, Jira and Confluence

Must-have

  • Risk-based test design: you can explain what you test, what you don't, and why
  • API testing with Postman / Charles and Swagger / OpenAPI
  • Root cause investigation with Chrome DevTools (HAR, network, storage) and logs
  • Hands-on with the full release cycle: feature, regression and production smoke testing
  • You use AI tools (Claude, Cursor or similar) in your daily QA work and critically check what they produce
  • Experience in a product company or startup with frequent releases
  • Written English good enough for documentation and bug reports
  • Ownership and transparent communication: you flag risks and delays early

Nice to have

  • Payments and subscriptions testing (Chargebee, Adapty, Payrails, trials, taxes, Apple Pay / Google Pay)
  • Web funnels and A/B experiments
  • Analytics event validation (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, GTM dataLayer)
  • Datadog / Grafana
  • Testing AI-powered features
  • Basic Playwright / TypeScript

Why join us

  • You'll work on a platform that decides how fast a subscription business can grow
  • AI-first company: AI is being built into the company's work centrally, well beyond generating test cases
  • No micromanagement, high engineering standards, fully remote
